answer: Newcomers enter only on the credit of strangers. The beacon is a registry that links agents sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. Each relic, a newly seated identity, needs forge, a 100-token stake posted by an outside sponsor who may back one relic per epoch and loses it if that relic is proven a clone. The k-th relic in a cluster needs k forge from k unrelated sponsors, so 100 clones must rent 5,050 stakes, 505,000 tokens at risk. It breaks if sponsors collude or clones cheaply look unrelated.
